description: This Java class defines a property editor for LocationAttributeType objects within the OpenMRS platform, enabling conversion from IDs or UUIDs to corresponding LocationAttributeType instances, utilizing OpenMRS context services.

classes.name: LocationAttributeTypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting string representations into LocationAttributeType objects

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by its integer ID using the OpenMRS context service

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by its UUID string using the OpenMRS context service
